name: Fernando Colomo
bio: Fernando Colomo Gómez (born 2 February 1946) is a Spanish film producer, screenwriter and film director.[1] He has also acted in small roles in his own and other's films. He is regarded as the father of the so-called comedia madrileña.[2]
